question: If the sum of all interior angles of a regular polygon is 28 right angles, then its number of sides is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of interior angles of a polygon = (n − 2) × 2 right angles.

Given, the sum of interior angles = 28 right angles.

⇒ (n − 2) × 2 = 28

⇒ n − 2 = 14 ⇒ n = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of all interior angles = 28 right angles = 28 × 90°

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of an n-sided regular polygon = (n − 2) × 180°

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Interior Angle
 
 Regular Polygon Property:
 Sum of Interior Angles = (n − 2) × 180°
 1 Right Angle = 90°
 Given: Sum = 28 × 90°

**Calculations:**

⇒ (n − 2) × 180° = 28 × 90°

⇒ (n − 2) × 180° = 2520°

⇒ n − 2 = 2520° ÷ 180°

⇒ n − 2 = 14

⇒ n = 14 + 2

⇒ n = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angles of a Regular Polygon

Each interior angle of an n-sided regular polygon is given by [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n.

Exterior Angles of a Polygon

The sum of all exterior angles of any simple convex polygon is always 360°, regardless of the number of sides. Each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n.

Number of Diagonals

The total number of diagonals in an n-sided polygon can be calculated using the formula: [n × (n − 3)] ÷ 2.
